meta.title: IVS — Intelligent Video Studio — cut video by editing text
meta.description: Transcribe, caption and export vertical video in Arabic, Darja and French. Your footage never leaves your device.

landing.faqQ1: Does my video get uploaded to a server?
landing.faqA1: No. Your media is stored in your browser's private file system (OPFS) and decoded locally. Only transcription sends extracted audio to the model provider, and that is skipped entirely when you choose Manual mode.
landing.faqA2: Arabic (Modern Standard), Algerian Darja, French, English and mixed Arabic-French code-switching, which is how most of us actually speak. Tamazight is on the roadmap.
landing.faqQ3: Is Quran matching safe to publish?
landing.faqA3: Every verse is matched against canonical Uthmani text and scored. Anything below our confidence threshold is flagged for human review before it can be exported — the app never silently approves a verse.
landing.faqQ4: What happens when I run out of minutes?
landing.faqA4: Your existing projects keep working, editing stays unlimited, and you can still export at 720p. Upgrade and the extra minutes apply immediately.
landing.faqQ5: Can I use it on a phone?
landing.faqA5: Yes, and it is built for it: pinned preview, finger-sized trim handles, bottom sheets and an export button inside thumb reach. Landscape works too.
landing.faqQ6: How do payments work in Algeria?
landing.faqA6: Chargily Pay handles CIB and Edahabia cards in dinars. Anywhere else, Stripe covers international cards. Both are verified webhook-side, and your plan is enforced on the server.
